snippet.title: Time Travel Is No Picnic – Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5287990/?l=english&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_en
Website: https://icecube-entertainment.de/
Time Travel Is No Picnic is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure about time travel, strange characters, tricky puzzles, historical disasters and a whole lot of bad timing.

Join Tom, a young metalhead searching for his missing father, as he is thrown across space and time — from the Titanic to mysterious islands and places he definitely never planned to visit.

Explore, combine items, solve puzzles, meet bizarre characters and try not to make history any worse than it already is.

Time travel is no picnic.
